title: Saran04's Vanilla+
description: Enhanced Vanilla+ Fabric Pack for Minecraft 1.21. Improves performance, enhances visuals and animations, and adds quality-of-life features for a smoother, more immersive vanilla+ experience.
body:
This modpack is built for Minecraft 1.21 (Fabric) and focuses on performance, immersion, and quality-of-life improvements while keeping the vanilla feel.

✨ Performance Boosters

Sodium, Lithium, Indium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast.
Massively improve FPS, reduce lag, and optimize rendering!

Reese’s Sodium Options & Sodium Extra.
Extra settings for visuals and performance.

🎨 Visual & Aesthetic Enhancements

Iris Shaders, Blur, Dynamic Lights, Cull Leaves, Falling Leaves, Visuality, Eating Animations, Not Enough Animations.
Brings Minecraft to life with smoother animations, soft lighting, and immersive visuals.

Enhanced Block Entities, Entity Culling, Entity Texture/Model Features, Animatica, Skin Layers 3D
Adds more detail and polish to mobs, blocks, and skins.

🛠 Quality of Life & UI Improvements

AppleSkin, Inventory HUD, Better Third Person, Dynamic Crosshair, FPS Display, Zoomify, ShulkerBoxTooltip, Journeymap, Mod Menu, Better Advancements.
Makes gameplay more intuitive, and customizable.

🌍 Immersion & Gameplay Tweaks

Eating Animation, Better Beds, Cave Dust, Dynamic FPS, ImmediatelyFast, FirstPerson
Small details that improve immersion without breaking vanilla balance.
